rows.name: model
rows.from: Maxim DS1685 datasheet 19-5215 rev 10/12, silicon serial number section (page 18): register 40h holds the model number 71h, read-only

rows.name: serial
rows.from: Maxim DS1685 datasheet 19-5215 rev 10/12, silicon serial number section (page 18): registers 41h to 46h, unique and read-only

rows.name: serial_crc
rows.from: Maxim DS1685 datasheet 19-5215 rev 10/12, silicon serial number section (page 18): register 47h, CRC over 40h to 46h

rows.name: century

rows.name: date_alarm
rows.from: Maxim DS1685 datasheet, wake-up section, as quoted by the sources consulted

rows.name: ctrl4a

rows.name: ctrl4a.pab
